owlbear.prompt: single creature, centered, full body side view of an owlbear walking on all fours, (four-legged bear body:1.2) with (dark brown fur:1.3) and big claws, (owl head with brown-feathered face, round yellow eyes and hooked beak:1.25), feathered neck and shoulders.
